clip_key: # Experimental (procedural talk): templates. The spanish is a general sentence, the english has slots that the
# plugin fills in game ({thing} from pools.tsv, {day} {here} {vessel} {alt_km} from the flight, {other} and
# {self} in intercom scenes). Versions split by | are picked per play. Every version of a line must fit every
# version of the lines around it. So one clip gives many subtitles, and it is still real loñapsE. New keys: tp_

english: Who took my {thing}? | Has anyone seen my {thing}? | My {thing} is gone. Again. | Okay. Who moved my {thing}? | {other}, did you take my {thing}?
spanish_rt: ¿Quién se ha llevado mi {thing}? | ¿Alguien ha visto mi {thing}? | Mi {thing} ha desaparecido. Otra vez. | A ver. ¿Quién ha movido mi {thing}? | {other}, ¿has cogido tú mi {thing}?

spanish: Yo no. Mira detrás de eso.
english: {not_me} Look behind the {spot}. | {not_me} Try the {spot}. | Check behind the {spot}, {other}. | Last time it was under the {spot}.
spanish_rt: {not_me} Mira detrás {del spot}. | {not_me} Prueba en {el spot}. | Mira detrás {del spot}, {other}. | La última vez estaba debajo {del spot}.

english: Oh. Found it. Next to my {thing:2}. | Found it. It was with my {thing:2}. | Oh. There it is. | Got it. Sorry, {other}.
spanish_rt: Ah. Ya está. Al lado de mi {thing:2}. | Encontrado. Estaba con mi {thing:2}. | Ah. Ahí está. | Ya lo tengo. Perdona, {other}.

english: What is that smell? Is that {food}? | Does anyone else smell {food}? | Something smells like {food} in here. | {other}, did you heat up the {food} again?
spanish_rt: ¿Qué es ese olor? ¿Es {food}? | ¿Alguien más huele a {food}? | Aquí dentro huele a {food}. | {other}, ¿has vuelto a calentar {el food}?

english: Better not ask, {other}. | You don't want to know. | Let's just say it was {food:2}. | Don't ask. Breathe through your mouth.
spanish_rt: Mejor no preguntes, {other}. | No quieres saberlo. | Digamos que era {food:2}. | No preguntes. Respira por la boca.

spanish: ¿A quién se le ocurrió este nombre?
english: Who named this thing {vessel}? | {vessel}. Who picked that name? | Why is this ship called {vessel}? | I still can't believe we fly the {vessel}.
spanish_rt: ¿Quién le puso {vessel} a este trasto? | {vessel}. ¿Quién eligió ese nombre? | ¿Por qué esta nave se llama {vessel}? | Todavía no me creo que volemos en la {vessel}.

english: That was your idea, {other}. | You picked it, {other}. | You voted for it. Twice. | It was that or {silly_name}.
spanish_rt: Fue idea tuya, {other}. | Lo elegiste tú, {other}. | Votaste a favor. Dos veces. | Era eso o {silly_name}.

english: Well, it was a great idea. | Fine. It's a good name. | Okay. Good name. | Fair enough.
spanish_rt: | Vale. Es un buen nombre. | Bueno. Buen nombre. | Me parece justo.

english: Last night I dreamt about {creature}. | I had that dream again. With {creature}. | I dreamt about {creature}. It knew my name. | Don't laugh, but I dreamt about {creature}.
spanish_rt: Anoche soñé con {creature}. | He vuelto a tener ese sueño. Con {creature}. | Soñé con {creature}. Sabía mi nombre. | No te rías, pero soñé con {creature}.

english: Again? That's the third time, {other}. | Again? You need more sleep, {other}. | Third time this week. | Was I in it? | Again? Stop eating {food} before bed.
spanish_rt: ¿Otra vez? Ya van tres veces, {other}. | ¿Otra vez? Tienes que dormir más, {other}. | Tercera vez esta semana. | ¿Salía yo? | ¿Otra vez? Deja de comer {food} antes de dormir.

english: How long have we been out here? | What day is it? | {other}, how many days has it been? | I've lost count of the days.
spanish_rt: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevamos aquí fuera? | ¿Qué día es hoy? | {other}, ¿cuántos días han pasado? | He perdido la cuenta de los días.

english: Day {day}. Too many. | Day {day}, I think. | No idea. Day {day}? | Day {day}. I counted on the wall.
spanish_rt: Día {day}. Demasiados. | Día {day}, creo. | Ni idea. ¿Día {day}? | Día {day}. Los he contado en la pared.

english: I thought it was fewer. | Feels like more. | That can't be right. | Huh. Only {day}?
spanish_rt: Creía que eran menos. | Parecen más. | Eso no puede ser. | Vaya. ¿Solo {day}?

spanish: Algo se ha soltado otra vez.
english: The {part} came loose again. | {other}, the {part} is loose again. | Is the {part} supposed to wobble like that? | Something rattles. I think it's the {part}.
spanish_rt: Se ha vuelto a soltar {el part}. | {other}, otra vez se ha soltado {el part}. | ¿Es normal que {el part} se mueva así? | Algo vibra. Creo que es {el part}.

english: Tape it, like the {part:2}. | Tape. Same as always. | Just use tape, {other}. | Tape it. Don't tell Control.
spanish_rt: Ponle cinta, como {al part:2}. | Cinta. Como siempre. | Usa cinta y ya está, {other}. | Ponle cinta. No se lo digas a Control.

spanish: Control, se nos ha acabado la comida buena.
english: Control, we are out of {food}. | Control, someone ate all the {food}. | Control, we ate the last of the {food}. | Control, food report: zero {food} left.
spanish_rt: Control, ya no queda nada {del food}. | Control, alguien se ha comido lo que quedaba {del food}. | Control, nos hemos comido lo último {del food}. | Control, informe de comida: no queda nada {del food}.

spanish: Os queda mucha de la otra.
english: You still have plenty of {food:2}. | Eat the {food:2}. | There's a full crate of {food:2}. | Try the {food:2}. It builds character.
spanish_rt: Os queda mucho {del food:2}. | Comed {el food:2}. | Hay una caja llena {del food:2}. | Probad {el food:2}. Forja el carácter.

spanish_rt: Control, la vista de {here} desde aquí es increíble. | Control, tendríais que ver {here} desde aquí. | Control, {here} parece tan pequeño desde aquí. | Control, podría mirar {here} todo el día. |  |  |

english: Copy. | Copy. Back to work. | Copy. Still a nice view. | [landed] Oh. Right. | [landed] Oh yeah. Still nice. | [prelaunch] Oh. Right. Soon, then.

english: Copy. | Copy. Nice. | Copy. Good to know. | [landed] Oh. Right. | [landed] Oh yeah. | [landed] I knew that. It was a test. | [prelaunch] Oh. Right. | [prelaunch] I knew that. It was a test.
Whose turn is it to {chore}? | Who's supposed to {chore} today? | Someone has to {chore}. Not me. | {other}, your turn to {chore}.
spanish_rt: ¿A quién le toca {chore}? | ¿Quién tiene que {chore} hoy? | Alguien tiene que {chore}. Yo no. | {other}, te toca {chore}.

english: Yours. Definitely. | Yours, {other}. I keep a list. | Not mine. I did it yesterday. | Yours. I checked the chart.
spanish_rt: | A ti, {other}. Llevo una lista. | A mí no. Lo hice ayer. | A ti. Lo he mirado en la tabla.

english: That's not fair. | I did it last time! | Fine. But you {chore:2} tomorrow. | I want to see that chart.
spanish_rt: | ¡Lo hice la última vez! | Vale. Pero mañana te toca {chore:2}. | Quiero ver esa tabla.

english: Did you hear that {noise}? | What was that {noise}? | There it is again. That {noise}. | {other}. Did you hear that {noise}?
spanish_rt: ¿Has oído ese {noise}? | ¿Qué ha sido ese {noise}? | Otra vez. Ese {noise}. | {other}. ¿Has oído ese {noise}?

english: Probably normal. | That's normal. I think. | It's the {outside_part}. Probably. | Ships make noises. It's fine.
spanish_rt: | Es normal. Creo. | Es {el outside_part}. Seguramente. | Las naves hacen ruidos. No pasa nada.

english: You said that last time. | You always say that. | That's what worries me. | You said that about the {part:2}.
spanish_rt: | Siempre dices lo mismo. | Eso es lo que me preocupa. | Eso mismo dijiste {del part:2}.

spanish: ¿Te has enterado de lo de Control?
english: Did you hear about Control? {rumor} | Guess what I heard. {rumor} | Don't tell anyone, but {rumor} | {other}, big news. {rumor}
spanish_rt: ¿Te has enterado de lo de Control? {rumor} | Adivina lo que he oído. {rumor} | No se lo digas a nadie, pero {rumor} | {other}, tengo noticias. {rumor}

english: I don't believe it. | No way. | That explains a lot. | Who told you that?
spanish_rt: | Imposible. | Eso explica muchas cosas. | ¿Quién te ha dicho eso?

english: Can you stop humming {song}? | {other}, you're humming {song} again. | If I hear {song} one more time... | Please. Not {song} again.
spanish_rt: ¿Puedes dejar de tararear {song}? | {other}, otra vez estás tarareando {song}. | Si vuelvo a oír {song} una vez más... | Por favor. Otra vez {song} no.

english: I wasn't humming. | That wasn't me. | It helps me think. | I wasn't. Now I am.
spanish_rt: | No era yo. | Me ayuda a pensar. | No lo hacía. Ahora sí.

english: Look out the window. That's {here}. | Come look at {here}, {other}. | {other}, look. {here} again. | Quick, the window. {here}!
spanish_rt: Mira por la ventana. Eso es {here}. | Ven a ver {here}, {other}. | {other}, mira. Otra vez {here}. | Rápido, la ventana. ¡{here}!

spanish: Ya lo he visto mil veces.
english: I've seen it a thousand times. | Seen it. Day {day} of seeing it. | Nice. Can I go back to sleep? | Still pretty, I guess.
spanish_rt: | Visto. Día {day} viéndolo. | Muy bonito. ¿Puedo volver a dormir? | Sigue siendo bonito, supongo.

spanish: Control, el experimento hace algo raro.
english: Control, the {experiment} is doing something weird. | Control, the {experiment} is making a noise. | Control, is the {experiment} supposed to glow? | Control, the {experiment} moved. By itself.
spanish_rt: Control, {el experiment} hace algo raro. | Control, {el experiment} hace un ruido. | Control, ¿{el experiment} tiene que brillar? | Control, {el experiment} se ha movido. Solo.

english: Write it down. That's science. | Don't touch it. Write it down. | Great. That's a paper. | Science! Write it down.
Control, can you send us some {food}? | Control, we need a new {outside_part}. | Control, any chance of a better {thing}? | Control, can we get more struts?
spanish_rt: Control, ¿podéis mandarnos {food}? | Control, necesitamos {un outside_part} de repuesto. | Control, ¿hay alguna posibilidad de {un thing} mejor? | Control, ¿nos mandáis más puntales?

spanish: Eso no entra en el presupuesto.
english: That's not in the budget. | Negative. {mc_excuse} | Not in the budget. {mc_excuse} | {mc_excuse} Sorry.
spanish_rt: | Negativo. {mc_excuse} | No entra en el presupuesto. {mc_excuse} | {mc_excuse} Lo siento.

spanish_rt: Control, informe del día. Día {day}, todo bien. | Control, día {day}. No se ha caído nada. | Control, informe del día {day}: {status} | Control, informe para el día {day}: {status}

spanish_rt: | Recibido, {vessel}. Seguid así. |  |

spanish_rt: Te apuesto mi {thing} a que tengo razón. | ¿Apostamos? El que pierda tiene que {chore}. | Te apuesto mi {thing}. | ¿Apuesta? El que pierda tiene que {chore}.

english: Deal. But this time you pay up. | Deal. You still owe me a {thing:2}. | Fine. Last time you cheated. | Deal, {other}. No cheating.
spanish_rt: | Hecho. Todavía me debes {un thing:2}. | Vale. La última vez hiciste trampa. | Hecho, {other}. Sin trampas.

spanish_rt: | Echo de menos {home_thing}. | Echo de menos nibréK. Hasta la cafetería. | {other}, ¿echas de menos {home_thing}?

spanish_rt: | Yo también. No se lo digas a Control. | Un poco. Echo de menos {home_thing:2}. | A veces. Sobre todo {home_thing:2}. | Seguimos en nibréK, {other}. | nibréK está justo ahí. Mira por la ventana. | Ni siquiera hemos despegado, {other}.

english: What would Jeb do right now? | What would Jeb do in this situation? | {other}, what would Jeb do? | Okay. What would Jeb do?
spanish_rt: ¿Qué haría Jeb ahora mismo? | ¿Qué haría Jeb en esta situación? | {other}, ¿qué haría Jeb? | A ver. ¿Qué haría Jeb?

spanish_rt: | Seguramente {jeb_idea}. | {jeb_idea}. Evidentemente. | Algo peligroso. Querría {jeb_idea}.

spanish_rt: | Mejor no hacer eso. | Aunque es tentador. | Bien. Hacemos lo contrario.

english: I can't stop hiccuping. | I have the hiccups again. | Hic. Sorry. Hic. | {other}, help. Hiccups.
spanish_rt: | Tengo hipo otra vez. | Hip. Perdón. Hip. | {other}, ayuda. Hipo.

spanish_rt: | Aguanta la respiración. No demasiado. | Prueba a {cure}. | Aguanta la respiración. O prueba a {cure}.

spanish_rt: | Control, {el outside_part} tiembla. ¿Es malo? | Control, todo se tambalea. Hasta {el part}. | Control, esto tiembla. Un poco. Mucho.

spanish_rt: | ¿Por qué pita {el beeper}? | ¿Qué alarma es esa? | {other}. Algo está pitando. Mucho.

spanish_rt: | Es el temporizador {del food}. | Ignóralo, {other}. Pita porque sí. | Siempre hace eso. Creo.
